findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "arm_price_trigger" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Arm a price trigger with webhook delivery. Arms a single-fire price trigger. NythosX checks the price every minute and POSTs a JSON event to your HTTPS webhook …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arm_price_trigger · Private data: get_track_record, get_trade_plan, get_signal_bias, arm_price_trigger · Public sink: get_trigger_status, arm_price_trigger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arm_price_trigger · Private data: get_track_record, get_trade_plan, get_signal_bias, arm_price_trigger · Public sink: get_trigger_status, arm_price_trigger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
